events.title: Oink — Steam Next Fest LIVE!
events.summary: We're celebrating Steam Next Fest with Oink Splash Party! See the game in action, and join the fun! Haven't tried it yet? The demo is free to play on Steam. Grab your friends and jump into the waterpark! Stay Oinky!!

events.title: Oink Splash Party is coming to Steam Next Fest October 19–26!
events.summary: Steam Next Fest kicks off on October 19, and Oink Splash Party is joining the festival! Our demo is already free to play on Steam, so there's no need to wait. Jump into the waterparks, get familiar with our oinky physics, and see what happens when a bunch of Oinks fight over an Octoball! We're still hard at work building towards Early Access, with more game modes, improvements, and plenty of new things planned for the full release. events.title: Oink Splash Party Demo Is Out Now! We're Joining Steam Next Fest!
events.summary: Hey everyone!We've been hard at work on Oink Splash Party, and we're really happy to finally put our demo in your hands! events.title: Dive into Oink Splash Party's Original Soundtrack!
events.summary: Dive into Oink Splash Party's Original Soundtrack! A handcrafted soundtrack, lovingly composed by Churi González. As the Game Demo and Steam Fest approach, we wanted to take you on a little dive into the funky music of the Oinks! Listen for free on YouTube! @TeamChiliGames More news regarding the Demo and Steam Fest coming very soon!
